user.title: Pasture location
user.description: Experimental weather/model diagnostics. No horse-grazing safety decision. Defaults come from Home Assistant.

weather.title: Weather and completeness policies
weather.description: Weather providers are conservatively labeled estimated. Estimates and forecasts require opt-in. Collection begins now; current values cannot fill yesterday's history. Soil sensors remain diagnostic only.

data.allow_forecast: Archive and use hourly forecast proxies (clearly labeled)
data.assume_clear_sky: Explicitly assume clear sky for missing daylight cloud coverage

paddocks.title: Reserve paddock identities
paddocks.description: Create independently managed paddocks. Each gets a device, results and controls. Initial dates are pragmatic growth-cycle placeholders.

source.title: Weather or station source
source.description: Use instantaneous for temperature, irradiance, cloud or humidity; counter/daily_reset for energy or rain. Weather proxy is estimated; weather observation requires verified observation semantics. Changes preserve past records.

data.offset: Calibration offset in normalized units (instantaneous sources only)
data.semantics: Measurement/calibration notes; attest observed weather only if verified
data.unit_override: Explicit unit mapping (blank uses entity unit)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure location
reconfigure.description: Prior timezone/location summaries remain archived under their original context. New boundaries are calculated separately.

error.invalid_settings: Check location, timezone, units and policy values.

error.invalid_paddocks: Enter distinct, non-empty paddock names, one per line.
error.invalid_paddock_settings: Check paddock name, index compatibility, justification and numeric settings.
error.cycle_confirmation_required: Confirm the current cycle and a valid start date. Reopen this paddock if its cycle changed.

add_paddock.title: Add paddock
add_paddock.description: Save configuration afterward to load its entities.

confirm_cycle.title: Confirm new growth cycle
confirm_cycle.description: Start a new cycle for {paddock}, replacing the active cycle starting {previous_start}. Previous cycles and results remain archived. Only this paddock is reset. Missing historical inputs remain missing.

paddock_settings.title: Paddock settings
paddock_settings.description: Settings apply immediately. Save configuration afterward to reload source subscriptions. Generic soil moisture remains diagnostic. A calibrated index requires compatible dimensionless wi and justification. Assumed wi is used only in the explicitly enabled scenario, throughout its cycle.

recalculate.description: Recompute 1–31 completed dates from retained observations; missing history stays missing.

start_new_growth_cycle.description: Archive the active cycle and start a new cycle for one paddock. Requires explicit confirmation and the current cycle ID.
